metadata.title: Cooky: what do I cook today?
metadata.description: Your recipe box, your kitchen and the weather, together. Cooky helps you decide what to cook, plan the week, shop once and cook with friends.

home.headline: What do I cook today?

trial.q: How does the free trial work?
trial.a: Your first paid plan starts with {days} free days. Cancel before the trial ends and you pay nothing. Each account gets one trial.

cancel.a: Yes, from Settings → Plan & billing. You keep your plan until the end of the period you paid for, then move to Free.

downgrade.q: What happens to my dishes if I move to Free?
downgrade.a: Nothing is deleted. If you have more than Free allows, you can still view and cook everything. You just can't add more until you're under the limit or upgrade.

tries.a: AI and import features use tries: one question, one dictation, one import or one spin. If something fails on our side, the try is given back. Free tries reset on the 1st of each month, paid plans on your billing day, and spins every day.

switch.q: Can I switch between Plus and Pro?
switch.a: Yes, any time, from Settings → Plan & billing. Stripe adjusts the price for the rest of your billing period.

payment.a: Payments go through Stripe, a secure payment provider. Cooky never sees your card number. You can update your card or download invoices any time.
